abstract: Quantize LLMs with NVIDIA Model Optimizer (nvidia-modelopt, NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer): hf_ptq.py post-training quantization to NVFP4, FP8, INT4 AWQ and MXFP8, qformat and recipe choice, AutoQuantize, KV cache formats, memory options, export to a unified Hugging Face checkpoint, and deployment checks on TensorRT-LLM, vLLM and SGLang. Verified against ModelOpt 0.47.0 and vLLM v0.31.0.
